# Design rules — Linear

<!-- source: https://linear.app · generated by lewitt from dna.json · do not edit -->

## Hard constraints (from Restraint principles — check these first)

### MUST NOT — Brand lives in white, not in colour
_Use white (#FFFFFF) on #08090A for the only high-contrast action and let everything else be grey._

- Forbidden class patterns: `(^|-)bg-(?!white|black|transparent|gray|neutral|zinc|slate|none)[a-z]+-(4|5|6|7)\d\d$`, `(^|-)text-(?!white|black|transparent)[a-z]+-(4|5|6)\d\d$`
- Why: On #08090A a white pill is already the loudest possible element; a coloured button would read as a template and compete with the product screenshot.
- Note: Any saturated fill/stroke belongs to illustration only, never to a control.

### MUST NOT — Depth is a ring, never a shadow ladder
_Use 1px inset/outset rings at 3-20% alpha; reserve soft blur for genuinely floating panels._

- Forbidden class patterns: `(^|-)shadow-(?!none|sm|inner)[a-z]+-[a-z]+`
- Upper bound: `box-shadow` ≤ 1px
- Why: On #08090A a drop shadow is invisible and a strong one muddies the surface; a hairline ring holds the edge without stacking depth.
- Note: Offsets must stay 0; blur is allowed only on floating overlays.

## Design principles

### Brand lives in white, not in colour [restraint]
- Deciding the action colour on a near-black marketing page. → **white-on-black primary action** over _a branded accent hue (Linear purple) across CTAs, links and states_
- Because: On #08090A a white pill is already the loudest possible element; a coloured button would read as a template and compete with the product screenshot.
- Evidence: e-nav-cta, e-text-pink-hero, e-text-primary

### Voice comes from weight, not from size [craft]
- Making a 64px headline feel authoritative without shouting. → **510/590 variable weights with negative tracking** over _700/800 bold headings with a 1.25 modular scale_
- Because: Heavy weights at 64px turn into a wall that drowns the dense product screenshot directly below.
- Evidence: e-weight-dist, e-h1, e-h2, e-h3

### One texture for UI, a poster line for marketing [system]
- Choosing the type scale for a page that mixes marketing copy and a UI mock. → **two-band scale (12-16 UI, 48-64 display) with nothing in between** over _a smooth 1.25x ramp (16/20/25/31/39/48)_
- Because: Intermediate sizes would make the app mock's own UI text compete with marketing headings.
- Evidence: e-size-dist, e-size-dist-customers, e-size-dist-pricing

### Depth is a ring, never a shadow ladder [restraint]
- Separating cards and panels on a near-black canvas. → **1px rings at low alpha** over _layered box-shadows (0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.3)) on every card_
- Because: On #08090A a drop shadow is invisible and a strong one muddies the surface; a hairline ring holds the edge without stacking depth.
- Evidence: e-shadows, e-shadows-other, e-home-surface

## System rules

- **White-only action color**: The only saturated accent is a one-off hero word; every actionable surface resolves to white-on-near-black or 1px rings.
- **Weight and tracking beat size jumps**: Hierarchy is carried by 400/510/590 and -2.2% tracking at display sizes, not by bold weights or a long type scale.
- **Tight UI band, wide display jumps**: 86% of text sits in 12-16px; display sizes jump straight to 20/32/48/64 with no intermediate steps.
- **Rings instead of shadows**: Depth is a 1px inset/outset ring at 3-20% alpha; only genuinely floating panels get a soft shadow.
- **Breathing room lives inside sections**: Section-to-section gap is 10px; the 224px of air is padding inside a band, not margin between bands.
- **Real product UI is the illustration**: The hero visual is a rendered app frame (232px sidebar + 1072px canvas) with real states, not abstract art.
- **Feedback motion only**: Transitions are 100-160ms on border/background/color, with :focus-visible and a reduced-motion branch present.
